title: Per-field size limits on received variable-length fields, as settings
description:
Mark, 2026-11-14: unbounded opaque<V>/CBOR text fields are a DoS vector; mimid should refuse oversized values it receives. Matches the held spec proposal (IETF notes/2026-11-14-mimi-issues-from-table-draft.md item 12): implementations SHOULD accept at least N octets, a receiver MAY refuse more. Found because Haven's mimi-core caps role_name at 1024 octets and mimid had no cap.

Settings (config, mimid's own policy choices per decision mimid-1wgh.52), defaults from the proposal: max_name_octets 1024 (role_name, bot name, room name/subject/mood), max_description_octets 4096 (role_description, bot description, abuse note, room descriptions), max_uri_octets 2048 (user/room URIs in participant lists, consent, keyMaterial, identifierQuery searchValue). Enforced where mimid receives the value: room-policy components in a Commit or at room creation, reportAbuse, identifierQuery, consent, keyMaterial. Refusal uses the error the operation already has for a malformed or invalid request. Codec crates stay limit-free (they implement the drafts as written). Existing caps stay: topicId 4096, HTTP body MAX_BODY_LEN.
notes: Implemented ab659a6; deployed to mimid.reviewcommit.com 2026-11-14 22:31:56Z (previous binary mimid.pre-limits). Live check: identifierQuery of 37 octets success, 2137 octets notFound.
